== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：ドッキングベイ３２７</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング ベイに行くには、1フォース必要。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング ベイに行くには、1フォース必要。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. To go from here to another docking bay, 1 Force is required. Dark Side. To go from here to another docking bay, 1 Force is required.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese omits English Your. Both sides require 1 Force to go to another docking bay rather than docking bay transit.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-deathstardockingbay327.gif|Original English face]], [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327]].</ref>
